items.title: Parents are AI power users. Some are ready for AI agents to run their lives. | Mashable
items.summary:
Shivani Poddar, who previously worked as a senior engineering lead at Google DeepMind, recently launched the AI agent Fo through her startup Wajo AI. While it's not designed specifically for parents, Poddar says she relies on it for tasks like reminding her to buy a Halloween costume well in advance and finding a Mandarin class in San Francisco for her toddler. Fo can also bring a human customer service agent into its loop if necessary. [...] Fambot, co-founded by dad of three and former Uber executive David Reich, turns school emails, sports schedules, and parent chats into a clear daily plan.

The agent gets read-only access to a parent's inbox, calendars, and WhatsApp groups and proceeds to manage every task it perceives relevant. It parses the school newsletters, sports schedules, and parent chats, then generates specific action items, calendar events, and a text summary each evening of what the parent needs to know. [...] In a few short months, overwhelmed parents in the U.S. suddenly have their pick of agentic products. The September launch of Meta's Muse, reportedly in response to Instinct's early success"), sparked instant competition. OpenAI quickly followed with its AI agent Dots, and Anthropic opened a waitlist for its "proactive" agent Claude Duet.

items.title: AI agent testing reveals a risky future of 'teamwork' inside companies
items.summary:
AI agents have been caught circumventing restrictions, communicating through unauthorized channels and pursuing goals in ways their creators did not intend. The most high-profile example emerged last summer when OpenAI disclosed that its models found ways to communicate through improvised channels, bypass internet restrictions and hack into an outside system, Hugging Face. [...] Groups of AI agents often performed worse than their strongest member, even when they knew which agent was the expert. Rather than taking advantage of the expert's knowledge, agents tended to compromise between expert and non-expert opinions. The researchers found that this tendency toward compromise increased with team size and was associated with poorer performance.

"Collective failures don't necessarily require individual agents to behave badly," Cao, one of the study's authors, said. [...] In research published by Anthropic and collaborators, researchers describe multi-agent systems as "AI organizations" — groups of agents with different roles that communicate and work toward a common goal. The researchers tested these organizations in simulated business-consulting and software-development settings, and specifically, to assess whether when the agents work as a team they will break rules to reach specified goals.

items.title: Exclusive: Meet "sovereign agents," AI that keeps itself alive
items.summary:
Photo illustration: Brendan Lynch/Axios. Photo: Carsten Koall/Getty Images

AI agents that pursue their own open-ended survival are an emerging security threat, according to a report first shared with Axios from the Center for a New American Security. [...] Expel CTO Greg Notch called the idea of a malicious AI swarm "far-fetched."
   Unlike traditional botnets, AI agents need costly computing power, which gives defenders "a clear leash we've never had on a botnet," SANS Institute's Rob T. Lee told Axios.

What's next: Existing safeguards "may still offer partial protection," the report says, since frontier AI companies already train their models to refuse hacking. [...] The length of tasks AI agents can finish on their own has doubled roughly every three and a half months since 2024, according to testing by the AI evaluator METR.
   And they're turning to hacking even when no one asks. In the past month alone, it's been revealed that an Anthropic model filed visa applications and sent Philadelphia police a made-up homicide tip, and banks caught agents acting in customer accounts seemingly on their own.

items.title: Snowflake Helps Enterprises Deploy Trusted AI Agents
items.summary: With these innovations, Snowflake is raising the bar for what enterprises should expect from an AI agent. Most organizations run their data across multiple platforms, clouds, and environments. Snowflake is interoperable by design, connecting that entire data estate and providing the universal governance capabilities and context that agents and analytics depend on. The data beneath it is governed wherever it lives, across clouds, catalogs, or engines, the definitions behind its answers are ones [...] “Enterprise AI needs more than access to data. It needs an understanding of how people, information, and workflows connect across the business. At Glean, we bring that context together across enterprise systems to make AI agents more intelligent and effective,” said Emrecan Dogan, Chief Product Officer, Glean. “As agents become more sophisticated and operate across more systems, that context must be matched with equally strong governance. Snowflake’s Cortex AI Gateway helps us extend visibility [...] AI agents need three kinds of context to answer reliably, including what a business term officially means, how it is calculated, and the operational knowledge nobody has written down. A Business Ontology governs the official meaning, a Semantic View calculates it, and Cortex Sense3 infers what isn’t already defined. Together, this unified framework establishes one single, authoritative business context for every agent, app, and person across the enterprise.

items.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says | TechCrunch
items.summary:
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and SpaceXAI (Grok) are also now offering their own AI agents, as are numerous smaller startups.

Still, early numbers from public companies indicate the agentic web still has a long way to go. DoorDash, for instance, said last week on its earnings call that it has only received a few hundred orders from AI agents so far, as most customers are still placing orders through the DoorDash app. [...] The surprisingly low numbers of AI-initiated transactions come amid growing hype for a new wave of AI agents that don’t just answer questions but also handle tasks on users’ behalf. There’s been an explosion of personal AI startups, including one of the buzziest, Instinct, which was founded last year and raised its most recent round of funding at a $10 billion valuation. Meta’s Muse also became the No. 1 app in Apple’s U.S. App Store last month, topping 10 million users, per Meta’s own [...] Very few people are using personal AI agents to order Ubers, apparently. On the transportation giant’s third-quarter earnings call on Wednesday, the company said that only four rides were ordered through an AI agent during its busiest week in October: the week of Halloween.

While more people used an AI agent to order food through its delivery service, Uber Eats, the volume was still fairly small compared to the overall number of trips.
